svg.title: ClearAI · the loop grows an ontology
svg.desc: Left: the epistemic loop — the ClearAI mark as a ring with seven labelled stages. Its emerald fact dot, sitting in the opening, is also the first node of the domain ontology on the right: one circle shape throughout, differing only in colour — dark for concepts, light for value forms, emerald for the instance; the instance carries two conflicting assertion edges.
